name: The Art of True Partnership
description: The fundamental philosophy of Pokémon training in Kanto emphasizes that the strongest bonds are built on mutual respect, understanding, and shared growth. This isn't just about battling - it's about becoming better beings together.

core_principles.description: Pokémon and trainers are equals in partnership, each bringing unique strengths
core_principles.practical_application: Always consider your Pokémon's feelings and preferences in decisions

core_principles.description: True strength comes from growing together, not from dominating
core_principles.practical_application: Learn from your Pokémon as much as you teach them

core_principles.description: The bond between trainer and Pokémon is emotional and spiritual, not just tactical
core_principles.practical_application: Spend time with your Pokémon outside of training and battles

core_principles.description: Every Pokémon has its own personality, needs, and growth timeline
core_principles.practical_application: Adapt your training style to each individual Pokémon

master_trainers_wisdom: The strongest trainer is not the one who wins every battle, but the one who brings out the best in their Pokémon
A Pokémon's trust is earned through consistency, kindness, and understanding
The journey matters more than the destination - enjoy every moment with your partners

name: Celebrations of Life and Bond
description: Kanto's seasonal festivals celebrate the deep connection between humans, Pokémon, and nature. These events strengthen community bonds and honor the relationships that make life meaningful.

festivals.name: Spring Awakening Festival
festivals.description: Celebrates new beginnings, the bonds between trainers and their first Pokémon, and the renewal of life
activities: First Pokémon ceremonies for new trainers
Flower crown making with Grass-type Pokémon
Community gardens planted with Pokémon help
traditional_foods: Moomoo milk fresh from Tauros farms
Honey cakes made with Combee honey
festivals.cultural_significance: Represents hope, new beginnings, and the endless potential of partnership

festivals.name: Summer Harmony Festival
festivals.description: Celebrates the peak of life energy, the strength found in diversity, and the joy of adventure
festivals.cultural_significance: Represents strength, diversity, and the joy of living fully

festivals.name: Autumn Gratitude Festival
festivals.description: A time to give thanks for the harvest, the lessons learned, and the bonds that have deepened
activities: Storytelling about lessons learned from Pokémon
traditional_foods: Pumpkin dishes grown with Pokémon help
festivals.cultural_significance: Represents gratitude, wisdom, and the richness of shared experiences

festivals.name: Winter Reflection Festival
festivals.description: A quiet time for reflection, remembrance of those who have passed, and preparation for new growth
activities: Ice sculpture creation with Ice-type Pokémon
festivals.cultural_significance: Represents remembrance, reflection, and the continuity of life

name: The Lost Chronicles of Kanto
description: Ancient history of Kanto reveals a time when the boundary between humans and Pokémon was less defined, and both species learned from each other in ways that shaped the modern world.

historical_periods.description: The legendary first partnership between a human and Pokémon that established the foundation for all future relationships
key_events: A human child saved a wounded Mew
Mew taught the child to communicate with all Pokémon
The child became the first 'Pokémon Whisperer'
The partnership inspired others to form bonds
historical_periods.cultural_impact: Established the principle that kindness and respect are the basis of all Pokémon relationships
archaeological_evidence: Ancient cave paintings showing humans and Pokémon working together
Carved stones with symbols representing different Pokémon types
Ruins of the first Pokémon sanctuary

historical_periods.description: A golden age when humans and Pokémon lived in perfect harmony, sharing knowledge and building civilization together
key_events: Construction of the first cities with Pokémon architecture
Development of agriculture with Grass-type Pokémon
Creation of the first healing techniques
Establishment of the Council of Species
historical_periods.cultural_impact: Demonstrated that cooperation leads to prosperity for all
lost_knowledge: Ancient healing techniques using Pokémon energy
Architectural methods that harmonized with nature
Communication methods that transcended language barriers

historical_periods.description: A period of conflict when some humans began to see Pokémon as tools rather than partners, leading to the Great Pokémon War
historical_periods.cultural_impact: Taught the importance of respecting Pokémon as equals and partners
lessons_learned: Power without compassion leads to destruction
Pokémon will not serve those who do not respect them
True strength comes from unity, not domination

historical_periods.description: The current era of renewed partnership, scientific understanding, and the development of modern Pokémon training
key_events: Founding of the first Pokémon research institutes
Creation of Pokémon Centers and healing technology
historical_periods.cultural_impact: Balanced scientific advancement with respect for traditional wisdom

name: The Language Beyond Words
description: The art of communicating with Pokémon goes far beyond simple commands. It involves understanding emotions, body language, energy patterns, and the unique ways each species expresses itself.

communication_methods.description: Connecting with Pokémon through shared emotions and empathy
Sensing the natural energy patterns and auras that Pokémon emit
Learning to read and respond to Pokémon body language and behavioral cues
Connecting with Pokémon through understanding their elemental nature

advanced_techniques.description: Sharing dreams and visions with Psychic-type Pokémon
Experiencing shared memories with your Pokémon

name: Guardians of the Sacred Balance
description: Legendary Pokémon are not just powerful creatures - they are guardians of natural balance, teachers of ancient wisdom, and bridges between the physical and spiritual worlds.

legendary_roles.description: Maintain the natural equilibrium between different forces
examples: Articuno maintains the balance of ice and cold
Zapdos governs the power of storms and electricity
Moltres controls the sacred flame of life

legendary_roles.description: Share ancient knowledge with those deemed worthy
examples: Mewtwo teaches about the nature of existence and consciousness
Mew shares the secrets of life and evolution
Celebi reveals the connections between past and future

legendary_roles.description: Protect the boundaries between different dimensions and realities
examples: Others maintain the stability of space-time
Some protect the boundary between life and death
sacred_duties: Protecting the cycle of life and death

encounter_protocols.description: Always approach legendary Pokémon with respect and humility
steps: Bring offerings of respect, not bribery

encounter_protocols.description: Legendary Pokémon often test potential partners

name: The Sacred Art of Restoration
description: Healing Pokémon involves more than just treating physical wounds - it requires understanding their emotional, spiritual, and energetic needs as well.

healing_philosophies.description: True healing addresses the whole being - body, mind, and spirit
principles: Spiritual wounds can manifest as physical symptoms
Healing requires addressing root causes, not just symptoms
The healer must also be in balance to help others

healing_philosophies.description: Healing works with natural processes rather than against them
principles: Nature provides all necessary healing tools
Timing and patience are crucial for recovery
Artificial interventions should support, not replace, natural healing
Prevention through proper care is better than treatment

healing_techniques.description: Using different berries for their healing properties
applications: Persim berries for confusion and mental clarity

healing_techniques.description: Channeling healing energy through touch and intention
Using natural environments to promote healing
